_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Nexus install directory layout. install.sh scaffolds every folder with class 'scaffold'; the engine creates class 'runtime' folders on first use (do NOT scaffold those). class 'managed' folders are created by another install mechanism (git clone, venv setup). Human-readable face + rationale: docs/DIRECTORY_LAYOUT.md. To add a specialized directory: add one entry here, and the installer + docs both follow. JSON (not YAML) on purpose — parsed with stdlib during early install, before the app venv/PyYAML exist.

_classes.scaffold: Organizational drop-zone the installer must create (nothing else does). Home-relative.
_classes.runtime: Machine-written state created by the engine on first use via mkdir(parents=True). Listed for documentation only; NOT scaffolded by the installer.
_classes.managed: Created by a dedicated install step (git clone / venv), not the folder loop.

folders.purpose: The Nexus application (git clone target): src/, config/, templates/, .env
Nexus's own runtime venv (installer-created; setup.sh activates it)
System-tool venv home — one subdir per tool (source stays in tools/)
System tool/engine SOURCE + shared vendored code (its venv lives in venv/)
Projects, one dir each — self-contained unit (source + its own venv + docs). Project-local knowledge (README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/*.md) is indexed from here under the 'projects' namespace.

CANONICAL memory store + MEMORY.md index. System-owned: every provider reads the SAME files, and a provider harness may shim in but never owns it. Holds cross-project and orphan-topic knowledge — anything with no project folder of its own. Without this entry a fresh install has nowhere to persist memory and comes up silently amnesiac (no error, just empty recall).

Operating context every provider loads: SOUL.md (system personality), AI_CONTEXT.md (portable rules), OPERATING_PROCEDURES.md, plus deferred context docs. System-owned, provider-neutral — a provider's native file shims in (CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md → @context/...), it never holds the content.
Platform/provider adapters
Agent definitions
Skills (provider dirs symlink INTO here; never own)
Watchers, monitors, one-shots, utilities
System configuration
Operator/app persistent data — cache, registries (core runtime DBs live in .local/nexus/, not here)
Logs
Snapshots (pre-change milestones + automated)
Docker stacks
Inbound drops awaiting review
Temp / working / disposable files (scratch, ephemeral screenshots)
Cached research artifacts
Scaffold root for install-local source
Scaffold root for install-local tests
Engine-created runtime DBs — RAG store, skill-metrics, triage-validation, session/journal/queue/staging/council state
Optional secrets override home (nexus.env); read if present, safely skipped if absent
